differences.decision: State.DONE.value is COMPLETED; readers accept DONE and COMPLETED
RuntimeAdapter has nine processing methods and ManagedAdapter has six management methods
Accept upstream exception object and 0.3.1 split exception keywords through typed overloads
Accept three-argument upstream and four-argument 0.3.1 forms
Restore upstream payload email parser and __mail.html behavior
Existing file or .json path selects upstream direct-file representation
Existing directory or non-JSON path preserves envelope and item-owned files
Reject absolute, traversal, separator, quote, control, and symlink escapes in both modes
BEGIN IMMEDIATE, conditional FIFO claim, deterministic rowid tie break
Open custom 0.1.6 and actions 0.3.1 schemas transactionally and idempotently
Preserve custom keys, TTL, origins, routing, atomic reservation, recovery, and attachments
Preserve custom documents, indexes, atomic claim, routing, recovery, and inline/GridFS attachments
AWS DocumentDB-specific behavior remains unverified and experimental
Official Robocorp Control Room HTTP adapter is excluded
Yorko remains optional and experimental until a live gate exists
Preserve actions.work_items, actions.workitems, actions_work_items, and from actions import workitems
Preserve seed/list/get/delete/stats/recovery for managed adapters and Action Server
